## Before submitting

Please read:

[Why is modifying or adding vehicle features through VAN/CAN difficult?](https://github.com/morcibacsi/PSAVanCanBridge/blob/v3/wiki/faq-adding-features.md)

Some requests may require reverse engineering, access to another bus, additional hardware, or a man-in-the-middle setup.

Describe the desired behavior as clearly as possible.
